newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan SESC has no comment on broker probe reports.
newsitem.headline: Japan SESC has no comment on broker probe reports.

text.p: A Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission official on Friday declined comment on media reports the securities watchdog was investigating three of Japan's Big Four brokerages in connection with a racketeer payoff scandal involving Nomura Securities Co Ltd.
Spokesmen for Nikko Securities Co Ltd, Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd and Daiwa Securities Co Ltd also declined comment on the reports.

Domestic media said this week that the SESC inspection of the three brokerages was focusing on possible illegal business practices following revelations of suspected illegal deals by Nomura with corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike.
